privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: As Prince, we attach great importance to protecting the privacy of our visitors and users. This Privacy Policy explains what personal data is collected when you visit our website, how it is used, protected, and your rights.

collectedInfo.title: 1. Collected Information
collectedInfo.description: The following information may be collected when you use our website:
items: Information transmitted through contact or application forms

collectionMethod.title: 2. Method of Collecting Personal Data
collectionMethod.description: Your personal data is collected through the following methods:
items: When you fill out contact forms
collectionMethod.note: Data is collected through automatic or non-automatic methods.

usagePurpose.title: 3. Purposes of Using Personal Data
usagePurpose.description: Collected data may be used for the following purposes:
items: Marketing and analysis activities (if consent is given)

sharing.title: 4. Sharing of Personal Data
sharing.description: Your personal data may be shared in the following cases:
items: With authorized public institutions in case of legal obligations
With third parties from whom services are received (hosting, infrastructure, email services, etc.)
If you have given explicit consent

storage.title: 5. Storage and Security of Personal Data
storage.description: Your personal data is stored for the periods specified in the relevant legislation and necessary technical and administrative measures are taken against unauthorized access.

cookies.title: 6. Cookies
cookies.description: Cookies are used on our website to improve user experience. You can reject or delete cookies from your browser settings.

updates.title: 7. Privacy Policy Updates
updates.description: This Privacy Policy may be updated when necessary. The current text is always published on our website.

privacy.contactEmail: You can write to our email address info@princetourismagency.com for your questions.

kvkk.intro: In accordance with the Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), Pro Health, as the data controller, processes your personal data within the scope described below.

processingPurpose.description: Your personal data is processed for the following purposes:

transfer.title: 4. Transfer of Personal Data
transfer.description: Your personal data may be transferred to authorized public institutions and organizations and third parties from whom services are received, in accordance with Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK.

collectionMethod.title: 5. Method of Collecting Personal Data and Legal Reason
collectionMethod.description: Your personal data is collected through the following methods:
collectionMethod.note: Your personal data is processed based on the legal reasons specified in Article 5 of the KVKK.

rights.title: 6. Your Rights Under KVKK
rights.description: In accordance with Article 11 of the KVKK, you have the following rights:
items: Learning whether your personal data is processed
Requesting correction if processed incorrectly or incompletely
Requesting notification of transactions to third parties
Objecting to analysis by automatic systems
Requesting compensation in case of damage
